subject: Novatech — product-use carveouts & feedback-license scope (MSA + Order Form redlines)
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@novatech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ward <tom.ward@novatech.com>, Novatech Legal <legal@novatech.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Novatech MSA/Order Form - redline upload and key asks

Marcus — attaching our redline (Novatech_MSA_Redline_v3.docx) and a simple productization matrix (ExhibitA-productization-matrix.xlsx). Summary of top-line asks so your team can triage before legal review: 

1) Output ownership: we are asking for assignment of rights to outputs created by our inputs so we can productize (we understand model weights remain with Redwood). We propose an explicit assignment for "Customer Output" as defined in the Order Form.

2) Training/data use: Novatech requires an opt-in for any training/retraining on our data; default should be no retraining. If Redwood wants to use customer data for model improvement, that must be mutually agreed and compensated.

3) Feedback license: we request a narrow license that permits Redwood to use runtime logs/feedback only to operate, troubleshoot, and improve the service for Novatech, but not to train general models or share with third parties.

4) Telemetry & evidence: we need clear telemetry retention limits and an audit-friendly evidence package (an index of logs and redacted examples) to satisfy our compliance team during procurement.

We'd like to avoid lengthy back-and-forth on definitions. Can Redwood propose language for an Exhibit A that maps productization use cases (internal-only, B2B redistribution, end-customer resale) to pricing tiers/fees and limits? Also proposing a short legal-only call next week to close open points.

Attachments: Novatech_MSA_Redline_v3.docx (docx, 172KB), ExhibitA-productization-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)

Thanks — Amy
Amy Chen
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novatech

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@novatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Novatech MSA/Order Form - redline upload and key asks

Amy — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. We're aligned on many practical points; a couple of clarifications from our side to speed the redline: 

- Output ownership: Redwood does not assign model weights or training pipelines. We can grant Novatech broad, perpetual, non-exclusive rights to use and sublicense "Customer Output" for your productization needs, but we need to limit the grant to outputs generated by your inputs during the term (not to pre-existing model IP). We'll draft specific wording that preserves your ability to ship features while protecting our model IP.

- Training/retraining: Agreed that opt-in should be the default. We'll propose a clause that requires explicit customer consent and a separate commercial addendum for any retraining.

- Feedback license: Redwood's standard position is to take a license to anonymized, aggregated telemetry for improving and monitoring the service. We understand Novatech wants tighter controls; we can propose a narrower clause that: (a) limits use to troubleshooting and model quality metrics for the contracted product, (b) prohibits use for general model training without a separate agreement, and (c) requires a minimum anonymization threshold.

- Exhibit A/productization tiers: good idea — Karthik and I will draft a compact matrix that maps productization scenarios to fees and controls (internal use / B2B embed / resale to end-customers).

Can we schedule a 30-minute legal-only call on Tue 8/3 or Wed 8/4 PST? If legal prefers, we can share a counter-redline first.

I'll attach our first-pass counter language tomorrow (will include a suggested Exhibit A).

Best,
Marcus
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Amy Chen <amy.chen@novatech.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Novatech MSA/Order Form - redline upload and key asks

Marcus / Olga — looping in suggested legal redline language below so we can be concrete on the call. Amy / Novatech legal: sharing early so you can react before the meeting. 

Suggested clauses (high level):

1) Customer Output: "Customer Output" means outputs (text, files, embeddings) generated by the Service in response to Customer Inputs. Subject to the Agreement and payment of applicable fees, Redwood hereby grants Customer a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, transferable right and license to use, reproduce, display, distribute and create derivative works of Customer Output solely for Customer's internal business operations and commercialization of Customer's products as specified in Exhibit A. Redwood retains all rights to the underlying model, training data, model weights, and model architectures.

2) Training & Model Improvement: Redwood shall not use Customer Inputs or Customer Output to improve or retrain Redwood's base models or model variants that are not part of the Customer's dedicated instance, unless (a) Customer provides written consent in a separate addendum, and (b) commercial terms are agreed. Runtime telemetry and anonymized usage metrics necessary to operate the Service (latency metrics, error rates, aggregate token counts) may be collected and used by Redwood for service reliability.

3) Feedback License: Customer grants Redwood a limited, revocable license to use anonymized, aggregated runtime telemetry and customer-provided feedback solely for service operation, debugging, and performance monitoring. Use of such telemetry for training general-purpose models requires explicit opt-in and compensation.

4) Exhibit A: will enumerate permitted productization scenarios and any surcharge/royalty structure for resale/reship.

Olga: please sanity-check; if OK I'll convert the clauses into tracked-change redline to circulate. Laura: we should confirm procurement milestone dates (SOW sign, DocuSign, KYC). Marcus: please propose times for Tue/Wed legal call.

-Karthik
Sr. Counsel, Contracts & Compliance
Redwood Inference
